name: humanize
title_zh: 41 种 AI 腔逐个挑出，改完才准进仓库
tagline_zh: 写稿、改稿、审稿时自动揪出「显著性通胀」「-ing 尾巴」「模糊归因」等 41 种机器味。
tagline_en: Drafting, editing, reviewing—it flags 41 AI-tells like significance inflation, -ing tails, vague attributions.
desc_en: Remove signs of AI-generated writing from prose, and keep it out of a repo. Use when drafting, editing, or reviewing text to make it sound natural and human, or when auditing a whole docs folder for AI slop. Detects 41 patterns across content, language, style, communication, filler, and rhetoric, including: significance inflation, promotional language, -ing tails, vague attributions, AI vocabulary
why_zh: 不是笼统说「这不像人话」，而是按内容、语言、风格、沟通、填充、修辞六类拆出 41 种可复现模式。
why_en: Instead of vague 'this sounds robotic,' it breaks AI-slop into 41 reproducible patterns across six categories, pinpoints each.
limit_zh: 只认英文文本；对中文、代码混排、诗歌或刻意风格化文本无效。它挑的是模式不是品味，若你本就爱用排比或夸张修辞，会被误报。
limit_en: English prose only; no code-mixed, poetic, or stylized text. It flags patterns, not taste—so deliberate anaphora or hyperbole will trigger false.
title_en: Strip 41 AI-tells from prose before it hits the repo
